sloka: मत्त कोकिल सन्नादैः नर्तयन् इव पादपान् ।शैल कन्दर निष्क्रान्तः प्रगीत इव च अनिलः ॥४-१-१५॥
transliteration: matta kokila sannādaiḥ nartayan iva pādapān ।śaila kandara niṣkrāntaḥ pragīta iva ca anilaḥ ॥4-1-15॥

translations.english: "As if the trees are dancing to the music of the cuckoos and to the sound of the wind coming out of the mountain-caves.
